description: This file defines the 'Session' class and related utilities for managing browser sessions, including starting/stopping daemons, connecting via sockets, and handling session data within the Playwright core project.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages a browser session, including running commands, stopping, deleting data, and managing connection to the session daemon.

classes.name: SocketConnectionClient
classes.description: Handles socket communication with the session daemon, including sending messages and handling responses.

methods.name: renderResolvedConfig
methods.description: Generates a human-readable configuration summary for a session.
